raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee ("Start-Up Fee") for a PETSMART VETERINARY SERVICES franchise is $10,000 and must be paid in full upon execution of the Franchise Agreement. The Start-Up Fee is non-refundable. We may elect to waive part or all of the fee. Our decision to waive all or part of the initial fee is based on our discussions with each franchise candidate. Because we sometimes waive all or part of the fee, the initial franchise fees paid are not uniform. In our last fiscal year, initial fees ranged from $0 to $5,000 (the maximum fee was $5,000 in the last fiscal year).
